name: Rewarx Studio AI
summary: AI product photography for Shopify and e-commerce sellers: turns one product photo into studio shots, model photos, ghost-mannequin images, mockups and listing sets, on monthly credits.
best_for: Shopify sellers in fashion, beauty, jewellery and home goods who need many consistent product, model and lifestyle images from one product photo and would otherwise pay for a shoot
skip_if: you want a vendor with a public track record and published refund terms, or most of your output must be video or 4K, where the credits run out quickly
honest_knock: It is a young app: the Shopify listing shows a launch date of 11 May 2026 and no reviews yet, so there is no public track record. Credits go fast once you use 4K or video: 100 credits buy about 100 standard photos but only about 33 4K photos or 5 videos. The listing states no refund terms, no rollover of unused credits and no price for extra credits, and Rewarx may bill some charges outside your Shopify invoice.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month on the Shopify App Store listing, billed in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on the Rewarx listing in the Shopify App Store; the listing says all charges are billed in USD) Rewarx's own pricing page shows no amounts, so the Shopify listing is the public price list. Free gives 10 AI product photo credits. Starter is $29.90 a month or $299 a year for 100 credits a month, Growth $54.90 a month or $549 a year for 200 credits, and Scale $129.90 a month or $1,299 a year for 500 credits; the annual price saves 17%. Credits are one pool for photos and video: the listing translates 100 credits into roughly 100 standard photos, or about 33 photos in 4K Ultra, or 5 cinematic videos. Starter removes the watermark; Scale adds batch templates and a dedicated support manager. The listing warns that external charges may be billed by Rewarx Limited separately from your Shopify invoice, and does not say whether unused credits roll over or what extra credits cost.
